name: Moc Chau food guide
summary: Cơm lam is the dish with a photograph: sticky rice cooked in a bamboo tube, named at Ban Ang. That plate was not taken in Moc Chau. Yogurt, hau plum, plateau tea, grilled fish, smoked meat, forest greens, and rice wine from a gourd are named and not pictured. The night market has no stall photograph. Prices and hours are check on arrival.
seoTitle: Moc Chau food — bamboo sticky rice, and what is not pictured
seoDescription: Sticky rice in a bamboo tube is the photographed plate, named at Ban Ang. Yogurt, plum, tea, and the night market are named, not pictured. Prices are check on arrival.
